rules.text: Junction posts do not come with trim. All trim must be specified separately.
Junction posts can be fastened to 90° corner or 120° corner junction blocks; posts can be added or removed from the junction blocks to reconfigure the application.
Fasteners are included with the junction blocks. For additional fasteners order part number T521882MP (quantity 50).

Junction posts are available in 30"H, 42"H, 48"H, 54"H, 66"H, and 78"H and can be ordered separately for building change-of-height junctions that are not supported by style numbers. Surface: black paint only.
90° corner and 120° corner junction blocks are available in packages of three, four, or five. Four fasteners are included with each junction block. Black paint only.

Inside corner light seals are sold in packages of four, available in 54"H, 66"H, and 78"H, and need to be specified in 90° corner junction applications (not required in 120° corner applications). Black paint only.
Inside corner light seals should be specified to the panel in a shorter 90° change-of-height corner; they can be field cut to accommodate shorter post heights.
Junction cap corner aligners (TS7CJCA10) must be ordered separately (package of 10). Junction caps: plastic or wood veneer.

90° junction caps can be used in L, T, or X applications and can be converted between applications by adding or removing a junction cap corner aligner. 120° junction caps can be used in V or Y applications and converted the same way.
90° change-of-height junction caps are used in some L, T, and X change-of-height junctions.
Junction cap aligners (packages of 10, black plastic only) need to be ordered for use with 90° change-of-height caps, and for all corner junctions that are not supported by style numbers.

Vertical trim aligners come in packages of four (black plastic only). L to T aligners connect an L change-of-height trim to a T vertical trim; 120° to V aligners connect a 120° change-of-height trim to a V vertical trim.

90° corner and 90° change-of-height corner junction caps include no aligners (all specified separately). 120° corner junction cap includes one integral aligner; additional aligners specified separately.

Thin end-of-run applications do not require a junction cap; the end-of-run trim connects with the panel top cap. Vertical trim aligners connecting end-of-run vertical trim to the top cap are included with the end-of-run vertical trim.
Thin end-of-run vertical trim can only be applied to end-of-run junctions manufactured on or after October 10, 2011.
Thin end-of-run vertical trim should be specified for the full height of the panel (base height plus stacking height, if stacking).
90° junction caps and junction cap aligners are not included with L or T vertical trim and must be ordered separately.
120° junction caps and junction cap aligners are not included with V vertical trim and must be ordered separately.
An L to T aligner (TS7LTA4) needs to be specified in applications connecting a thin L change-of-height trim to a T vertical trim.
A 120° to V aligner (TS7120VA4) needs to be specified separately in applications connecting a thin 120° change-of-height trim to a V vertical trim.
L, T, V vertical trim and all change-of-height trim heights should be determined using the build your own change-of-height junctions or build your own stacking junction sections of the guide.
Vertical trim aligners to connect the change-of-height end-of-run/in-line vertical trim to the top cap are included.
Thin end-of-run/in-line, L corner, T corner, 120° corner and V corner change-of-height trims can only be applied to junctions manufactured on or after October 10, 2011.
Thin vertical trim cannot be mixed with square or oval trim on an application. Thin trim must be used on the entire application.
When ordering vertical trim for a stacking application, specify it to span the full height of the base junction plus the stacking junction.
Thin change-of-height trim cannot be used with square or oval top trim.
Vertical trims (EOR, L, T, V) exist for panel heights 30, 42, 48, 54, 60, 66, 72, 78, 84, 90"; change-of-height trims exist for 12, 18, 24, 30, 36".
Junction post can be used at an end-of-run configuration or to change a junction application between an L, T, X, V, or Y.
Gripper glide caps only work on glides of junctions manufactured on or after October 10, 2011.
Same-height corner: start with the lowest panel height. If the lowest height is 48" or less, start with 2 blocks; if 54" to 78", start with 3 blocks.

Style numbers are provided for all L, T, X, V, and Y change-of-height applications with two heights (pages 350-358). Applications with three or more heights (all three-height T, X, Y and all four-height X) must be built from components.
Junction caps are always located at the second tallest panel height. If there are two panels at the same tallest height, the junction cap is located there.
L to T aligners or 120° to V aligners are required in certain change-of-height applications to provide consistent alignment of trim pieces.

Inside corner light seals: two for a T corner, four for an X corner, none for a Y corner. Sold in packages of four in 54", 66", 78"; specify the height corresponding to the tallest junction and field cut as necessary. (TS754ICLS, TS766ICLS, TS778ICLS)
Junction posts: determine the post heights for each leg of the corner junction corresponding to the panel heights (Side A, B, C, and D for X with four different heights).
Step 3a (T or Y junction, three different panel heights): if the shortest panel is 48" high or lower, order three blocks; if the shortest panel is 54" high, order four blocks.

Step 3b (X junction, three different panel heights): if there are two panels at 78" high and the lowest panel is 54" high, order five blocks; if there is a panel less than or equal to 48" high and only ONE panel at the tallest height, order three blocks; for all other change-of-height configurations order four blocks.
Step 3c: for all X junctions with four different panel heights use four blocks.

T change-of-height (3 heights) Option 1: posts A,B,C; blocks per step 3a; light seals; trim: end-of-run COH = A-C (TS7__TICHT(W)), T COH = C-B (TS7__TCTCHT(W)), T vertical = C (TS7__TTVT(W)), 90° COH corner cap TS790COHJC(W), junction cap aligner TS7CJCA10.
T change-of-height (3 heights) Option 2: end-of-run COH = A-B, L COH = B-C (TS7__TCLCHT(W)), T vertical = C, 90° COH corner cap TS790COHJC(W), L to T aligner TS7LTA4, junction cap aligner TS7CJCA10.
T change-of-height (3 heights) Option 3: end-of-run COH = B-C, L COH = C-A, T vertical = A, 90° COH corner cap TS790COHJC(W), L to T aligner TS7LTA4, junction cap aligner TS7CJCA10.

Y change-of-height (3 heights) Option 1: posts A,B,C; blocks per step 3a; no light seal; 120° COH = A-B (TS7__T120CHT(W)), V COH = B-C (TS7__TVCHT(W)), 120° corner cap TS7120JC(W), 120° to V aligner TS7120VA4.
X change-of-height (3 heights) Option 1: T COH = A-B, T COH = A-D, 90° junction cap TS790JC(W), two junction cap aligners TS7CJCA10, L to T aligner TS7LTA4. Blocks per step 3b.
X (3 heights) Option 2: L COH = A-C, T COH = C-B, 90° junction cap TS790JC(W), two junction cap aligners TS7CJCA10.
X (3 heights) Option 3: end-of-run COH = A-B, T COH = B-C, 90° COH junction cap TS790COHJC(W), two junction cap aligners TS7CJCA10.

X (3 heights) Option 4: end-of-run COH = A-C, T COH = C-B, 90° COH junction cap, two junction cap aligners. Option 5: end-of-run COH = A-D, L COH = D-C, 90° COH junction cap, junction cap aligner. Option 6: end-of-run COH = D-B, two T COH = B-A, 90° COH junction cap, junction cap aligner.

X (4 heights) Option 7: end-of-run COH = A-D, L COH = D-C, T COH = C-B, 90° COH junction cap TS790COHJC(W), junction cap aligner TS7CJCA10, L to T aligner TS7LTA4. Option 8: end-of-run COH = A-C, T COH = C-B, T COH = C-D, 90° COH junction cap, junction cap aligner. Blocks per step 3c.

Practice example 1 (X, 4 heights 66/54/42/30): TS766JP, TS754JP, TS742JP, TS730JP; TS790JB4; TS766ICLS; 12" EOR COH (printed TS712TCICHT), TS712TCLCHT, TS712TCTCHT, TS790COHJC, TS7LTA4, TS7CJCA10. Junction cap at second tallest height; a panel is higher, so 90° change-of-height junction cap.

Practice example 2 (X, 3 heights 54/54/42/30): TS754JP x2, TS742JP, TS730JP; TS790JB4; TS766ICLS; TS712TCLCHT, TS712TCTCHT, TS790JC, TS7LTA4, TS7CJCA10 x2. Two panels at tallest height, so a 90° junction cap instead of a 90° change-of-height junction cap.
Practice example 3 (Y, 3 heights 54/42/30): TS754JP, TS742JP, TS730JP; TS7120JB3; no light seal; TS712T120CHT(W), TS712TVCHT(W), TS7120JC(W), 120° to V aligner (printed TS7120A4).

Build your own 3" inline junction: 2 panel junctions TS7__TEPJ, 2 junction block packs (TS790JB3, 3 pack - need 2), 1 junction cap TS790JC, 2 junction cap aligner packs TS7CJCA10, 2 T vertical trims TS7__TTVT. Example at 54": 2 TS754TEPJ, 2 TS790JB3, 1 TS790JC, 2 TS7CJCA10, 2 TS754TTVT.
Same height stacking junctions are supported as style numbers (pages 362-363); build-your-own stacking only when there is no pre-configured stacking junction style number.
Step 3: omit ALL trims on the base application (this omits the junction cap and aligners as well).
Maximum height that an Answer panel can reach is 90". Maximum height that can be stacked on a base panel is 36", consisting of one 24"H and one 12"H or two 18"H stacking junctions.

In-line stacking: specify an in-line stacking junction for the shared junction at the shortest height of the stacking junctions; specify an end-of-run stacking junction for the difference between the tallest and lowest stacking junction; stacking junctions not in-line get end-of-run stacking junctions.

Corner (L, T, X, V, Y) stacking junctions are created by attaching thin end-of-run stacking junctions and junction blocks. Thin end-of-run stacking junctions are also used to create an in-line change-of-height condition. In-line stacking junctions are only used for in-line stacking when adjacent panels are the same height.

Each stacking junction needs to be connected by at least one stacking horizontal frame package. If one side of the panel section has two stacking junctions and the other side has one, two stacking horizontal frame packages are needed; if one stacking junction on both sides, one shared package.
Junction blocks are required at the top of each junction whenever there are two or more junctions or stacking junctions adjacent to each other in a corner application.

90° applications: same-height base stacking to same-height, or change-of-height base stacking to same-height → 90° corner junction cap; junction cap aligners = number of panels connecting to the junction cap.

90° applications: change-of-height base stacking to change-of-height, or same-height base stacking to change-of-height → 90° corner change-of-height junction cap; junction cap aligners = number of panels at the second tallest height.
120° applications (V or Y) require a 120° junction cap; junction cap aligners = one less than the number of panels connecting to the junction cap.

Trim, 90° Level 1: one panel at tallest height → end-of-run/change-of-height trim = tallest minus second height; two panels at tallest in an L → L trim = tallest minus third height (could be to floor); two at tallest along spine of T → T trim = tallest minus third height (two T trims, check both sides of spine); three at tallest → T trim = tallest minus fourth height (could be floor).

Trim, 90° Level 2: two panels at second height or higher in an L → L trim = second minus third height; two at second height along spine of T → T trim = second minus third (could be floor; two T trims); three at second height or higher → T trim = second minus third. Level 3: three panels at third height → T trim = third minus fourth.

Trim, 120°: Level 1: one panel at tallest → 120° change-of-height trim = tallest minus second; two at tallest in a V → V trim = tallest minus third (could be floor). Level 2: two at second height or higher in a V → V trim = second minus third (could be floor).
Stacking: specify inside corner light seal to match the overall height of the lower panel in the application (used only on 90° applications).
If both L and T trims are at one junction, an L/T aligner is needed; if both 120° and V trims are at one junction, a 120°/V aligner is needed.
Base horizontal frame packages include horizontal connecting bars, a top cap and a pair of base trims; cable tray and base cable tray are options. They do not include vertical junctions or skins.
The top horizontal bar can be lowered to a maximum of 24" from the top position. The bottom bar must always be positioned in the lowest slot in a junction.
Base trim with knockouts: top knockout is for power, bottom knockout for communication. Filler to close unused openings from Service Parts (TS7BTFSR).
Two horizontal connecting bars must be used in each base panel. Horizontal bars determine panel width and are not dedicated to a panel height.

Top horizontal bar may be lowered to allow for a 12"H, 18"H, or 24"H glass window or consolidation point kit at the top of the panel. Bottom horizontal bar in base panel must remain in lowest position.
Thin, square, and oval top caps can not be mixed between adjacent panels. Horizontal frame packages should be specified with Thin trim (this section).
Change-of-height top cap option is only needed when using in-line change-of-height.

Omit top cap option should be selected when adding a frameless glass screen to the top of the panel or when spanning a single top cap across multiple panels; then specify a spanning top cap separately. Spanning top cap width must match total width of spanned panels.
Spanning top caps can only be used in an in-line condition; they cannot span over a corner junction. Spanning top caps can be used on any panel height.
In-line spanning top cap lightseals should be specified separately for each in-line panel joint the top cap spans.
Omit base trim option should be selected when using skins to the floor.

Open base trims do not accommodate power and data routing or entry in the base. Open base trim can only be added on a junction manufactured on or after October 10, 2011. Open base trims occupy the bottom 3 1/4" of the panel; opening height 2 1/2".
Base cable tray is used only in the base; it cannot be used if omit base trim is selected for one or both sides of panel or if open base trim is used.
Cable tray can be positioned every 6" vertically above the base. Cable tray can accept cable carriers (see Montage guide, ZCC).
Paint color chosen on base trim also applies to the top cap; they are not chosen independently. Wood veneer top cap is an option.

Answer panel wood trims are only available with quarter-cut finishes except maple (flat-cut only). Flat-cut specified on non-maple gives coordinating quarter-cut; quarter-cut specified on maple gives coordinating flat-cut.
Use a cable tray to provide extra support for 60"W and 72"W full skins where people may lean against the panel.
Omit base trim and separately specify hardwire base trims when accessing hardwire power in the base.
When open base trim option is selected, both base trims are omitted.
Base trim knockouts-one-side/plain-one-side and plain-both-sides options: 24"W to 72"W only (18"W base trim is plain only). Change-of-height at both ends of top cap: 36"W and wider packages only.
Each stacking segment must have one horizontal connecting bar. Exception: if a window is used with stacking junctions, a horizontal connecting bar is not needed (12"H, 18"H or 24"H window).

Each stacking junction is specified separately (pages 362-363). Vertical trim must be specified separately to span the full height of the base junctions plus the stacking junction. Skins ordered separately.
Base panel must always have two horizontal connecting bars. When double stacking junctions, at least one of the stacking junctions must be connected with a horizontal beam.
No more than two windows can be stacked on top of each other. Consolidation point kit cannot be used with stacking components.
Stacking horizontal frame package is used when an additional horizontal bar is needed in off-module applications. Stacking stability guidelines on page 124.
Top cap is not included with stacking horizontal frame package; use the top cap from the base panel you are stacking on.
Frameless glass screens with recessed attachment can be used on panels with thin profile trim only.
Recessed kit includes glass screen, supports, and top caps. Two brackets/supports on 24"-72"W panels; three on 78" and wider. Gap between adjacent glass screens is 1/8".
Frameless glass screen can be placed on the top of a panel only; the top beam must be located in the top position of the frame. Can be used on base or stacking panels.
Frameless glass screen cannot be used when a window is located in the top position of the panel.
Frameless glass screen will not fit between two in-line change-of-height trims.

At an in-line change-of-height condition, a change-of-height top cap should be specified (glass shortened, top cap supports change-of-height on one end only). A change-of-height top cap is not needed at a corner change-of-height condition.
In-line spanning top cap lightseal must be specified separately; specify one for each in-line junction the frameless glass screen spans.
A single recessed frameless glass screen can span over two or more inline panels up to 96". Frameless glass screens with recessed attachment cannot span a corner junction.

Plastic end-of-run and junction cap aligners manufactured after November 2012 accommodate recessed frameless glass; aligners manufactured before November 2012 cannot, and new aligners will need to be ordered.
Each recessed frameless glass kit comes with two aligners to align top caps when two kits are used in an inline condition.

A recessed frameless glass top cap connector (TS7TFGRC) must be specified when a frameless glass screen is adjacent to a corner junction and the glass top caps are at a different (lower) height than the junction cap.

In a wall-start application or when frameless glass is on an off-module fin panel, the wall-start option should be selected and a recessed frameless glass top cap connector (TS7TFGRC) must also be ordered.
When using frameless glass on a spine panel with a same height off-module panel connection, the off-module cannot connect within 10" of an end-of-run or in-line junction connection.

When omitting glass and using acrylic or 3form material, additional support clamps may need to be ordered as service parts (T522096SR or T522097SR). Frameless glass kits 54" to 72" will also require additional support clamps; maximum distance between clamps is 48".

Frameless glass kit is available without glass screen to accommodate customer's own glass (see field-installed glass size requirements). Steelcase recommends safety glass meeting ANSI Z97.1 for field installed glass.
Field-installed glass (recessed): heights 9 5/16", 15 1/2", 21 5/8"; max width = nominal width − 1/8" (standard) or − 9/16" (change-of-height one end); thickness range .350-.4500".

TS7TFGRC must be ordered: wall start junction with recessed glass on the panel directly adjacent to the wall; recessed glass on an off-module fin panel; recessed glass adjacent to a corner junction with glass top caps lower than the junction cap; recessed glass coming into an in-line change-of-height condition with glass top caps on the lower panel height.
Specify omit top cap on the panel's frame package/panel package when adding a frameless glass screen (glass kit includes its own top caps).
Frameless glass screens with clip attachment can be used on panels with thin profile trim only.
Clip kit includes glass screen, brackets, supports, and top cap with holes to accommodate brackets. Gap between adjacent glass screens is 1/4".

90" and 96" wide clip frameless glass screen kits include three brackets: two attach to supports below the top cap; the third attaches only to the top cap through a hole drilled by the installer on site.
A single clip frameless glass screen can span over two or more panels.
Template tool from Service Parts (T511082SR) locates holes to drill on the beam of an existing panel for supports; only applies to beams produced prior to September 2009 (later beams include holes).

Field installed glass should always be tempered. Laminated glass must not be used (clip attachment). Field-installed glass: max height 11 3/4", max width nominal − 1/4" (standard) or − 3/4" (change-of-height one end), thickness .350-.400".
Top cap mounted storage allows existing c:scape, Duo, and Elective Elements storage to be mounted on top of Answer panels with thin trim only.
Solution comprises three elements specified separately: standard c:scape, Duo, or Elective Elements storage; top cap mounted storage bracket; top cap and aligner packages.
Two brackets for center mounted (all sizes) or aisleway with storage 30"W-48"W; three brackets for aisleway with storage 54"W-72"W. Can be mounted on- and off-module.
Maximum storage unit length for top cap mounting is 72"; storage wider than 72" cannot be top cap mounted.
Top cap mounted storage can only be used on base panels, not stacking panels. Top beam must be in the top position of the frame. Usable with painted and wood trims.

Cannot be used in a change-of-height condition when the storage is on the lower panel and matches the panel width; can be used if the storage is narrower than the panel. Will not fit between two change-of-height trims if the storage is the same width as the panel.

A top cap connector aligner (TS7TFGRC) must also be specified when storage is used on-module next to a wall-start junction, on an off-module panel, or in a corner change-of-height where the storage is on the lower panel.

When storage matches panel width (on module), standard top caps from the horizontal frame package can be omitted. When it does not match the panel width, standard top caps remain specified (field cut to size) to finish where no storage is present.
In-line spanning top cap lightseal must be specified separately; one for each in-line junction the top cap mounted storage spans. Top cap mounted storage can span both in-line and corner junctions.
End-of-run and junction cap aligners manufactured after November 2012 accommodate top cap mounted storage top caps; earlier aligners require new aligners.
Duo and Elective Elements storage can be top cap mounted on Answer panels up to 48"H; c:scape storage on panels up to 42"H.

Both center and aisleway conditions accept storage up to 72"W. Center mounted accepts storage up to 25"D; aisleway up to 17"D. Aisleway storage overhangs the back of the panel 3 1/2". Storage cannot overhang an end of run or corner junction more than 3 1/2" (ADA).

Brackets should be mounted within 10" from the end of the storage unit; use predrilled holes in the Answer horizontal bar where possible; for aisleway storage larger than 48"W additional holes need to be drilled into the beam.

When mounting Elective Elements personal storage, a proud back should be specified. c:scape personal and slim storage will have extra visible holes on the bottom. 1/2" gap between top cap and bottom of storage.
Universal tie plates (TS7TIEPLATE) help align two storage units mounted in-line with no gap; use two, one near each edge. With c:scape storage order pan head self drilling fasteners (853108629MP).

Compatible storage — Duo: BDTD54, BDTD66 (Shared Tall); BDTS54, BDTS66 (Individual Tall); BDS54, BDS66 (Slim). c:scape Personal Tall: CQMT173015P, CQMT173615P, CQMT174215P, CQMT174815P, CQMT176015P, CQMT176615P, CQMT177215P. c:scape Shared Tall: CQMT173015S, CQMT173615S, CQMT174215S, CQMT174815S, CQMT176015S, CQMT176615S, CQMT177215S. c:scape Personal Slim: CQMS173007P, CQMS173607P, CQMS174207P, CQMS174807P, CQMS176007P, CQMS176607P, CQMS177207P. c:scape Shared Slim: CQMS173007S, CQMS173607S, CQMS174207S, CQMS174807S, CQMS176007S, CQMS176607S, CQMS177207S, CQMS246007S, CQMS246607S, CQMS247207S.

Shared Organizer for FrameOne: E6SF15307, E6SF15367, E6SF15427, E6SF15487, E6SF15607, E6SF15667, E6SF15727.

Top cap and aligner packages should be specified to match the width of the storage unit being top cap mounted, not necessarily the panel width. On-module: standard frame top caps can be omitted; off-module: standard top caps should NOT be omitted.

Panel packages include two monolithic fabric skins and a horizontal frame package. Junctions (in-line, L, T, V, X, Y, end-of-run; wall-start and off-module connectors) are ordered separately and are always shared by adjacent panels.

Power and communication can be accessed by cutting skin in the field; templates from Service Parts (T500940SR); skin cutout filler (TS7STFSR). Power can be field-installed every 12" vertically using powerkits.
Specify powerkits where power is needed: either as an option on the panel package or ordered separately. Cable trays and base cable trays are optional.
Fabric vertical application (side 1/side 2) is available on 18"W to 60"W panels only; 72"W panels accommodate fabric in the horizontal application only.

18"W panels can accommodate pass-through power only (no powerkit). Pass-through harness: +$158 18"W-48"W, +$176 60"W-72"W. Powerkit: +$196 24"W-48"W, +$297 60"W or 72"W. Wiring schematic must be indicated: 3+1, 2+2, or 3SN.
Wood top cap: +$183 on 18"W-48"W, +$244 on 60"W-72"W.
Base cable tray cannot be used if open base trim is selected.
Remember to order receptacles and faceplates (pages 477-479).
18" wide base trim is only available in plain (no knockouts); plain option on 24"W-72"W only.
Open base trim can only be used on junctions manufactured on or after October 10, 2011.
